lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows, with higher density visible in the upper mid-section of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are observable, intersecting with the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a grid-like visual structure along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is present on the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on its dorsal edge to a shadow-cast lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated dark silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached to or swimming closely beneath the ventral region of the shark.
